item.summary: Union Minister for Agriculture & Farmers' Welfare and Rural Development, Shri Shivraj Singh Chouhan, held a comprehensive and productive meeting today with the Chief Minister of Madhya Pradesh, Dr. Mohan Yadav, along with State Ministers Shri Prahlad Singh Patel and Shri Aidal Singh Kansana, and senior officials, to review key proposals aimed at accelerating agricultural growth and rural…
item.title: Union Minister Shri Shivraj Singh Chouhan Holds High-Level Meeting with Madhya Pradesh CM Dr. Mohan Yadav on Agricultural and Rural Development Proposals Centre Approves ₹643.14 Crore for Construction of 223 Bridges in Madhya Pradesh
